# ezghcloud_volume (Resource)

An independently managed empty block volume. Size is an exact decimal byte count and can grow in place.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.
- `size_bytes` (String) Exact positive decimal size in bytes. Shrinking is refused.
- `volume_type` (String) Catalog volume type. A type change replaces the volume.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean)
- `iops` (Number)
- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for each asynchronous operation, for example 30m.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
- `throughput_mbps` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed resource identifier.
- `operation_id` (String) Most recent operation initiated by this resource; unavailable on import.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_volume.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
